name: Protector of the Wastes
oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters or becomes monstrous, exile up to two target artifacts and/or enchantments controlled by different players.
{4}{W}: Monstrosity 3. (If this creature isn't monstrous, put three +1/+1 counters on it and it becomes monstrous.)
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters or becomes monstrous, exile up to two target artifacts and/or enchantments controlled by different players.

needs.what: a target spec that is both size-capped ("up to two", count 2 + optional) and constrained so no two chosen targets share a controller ("controlled by different players") -- i.e. allow `one_per_player` on a fixed numeric `count` with `optional: true`, treating the count as the ceiling of the variable-size choice
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `one_per_player` is refused by the loader unless `count` is "any"; with "any" the ceiling is the number of players, so in a four-player Commander game the trigger could exile up to four permanents instead of two. The engine's `size_cap` in targeting.py would do exactly this but is internal (strive/casting) and not reachable from the DSL; dropping `one_per_player` instead would let both targets share a controller
